not_measured_on_purpose: the fill count. Settlement publishes one on-chain instruction per trade, so that count is exact and free to anyone with a node; a noised version would protect nothing and be worse than the free answer.
question: whether a block-range question about distinct requesting entities carries anything, and at what range width

real_identities.what_this_cannot_say: UniswapX records fills, so these are settled requests. QOMM's denominator includes requests that settled nothing, and no chain records those. If they come from a different population the relation here does not carry.
real_identities.why_not: 48,000 swappers over 1.43M blocks with 60% appearing once. The pool is unbounded against any range an asker names, so the count is close to linear in width. The one-window saturation on the simulator was the round-robin assignment.

saturation_definition: width at which the true distinct count reaches 95% of the entities seen
